text: This is Jordan and he made 600k in the last 30 days with his supplement brand. On top of that, I'm also doing $2.5 million in MRR with my own supplement brand as you can see here. Now we all know that general dropshipping, fashion dropshipping, or even building a one-time purchase brand is dying in 2026. High dispute rates, payment holds, and the worst part of it all is that you're not building something that you can eventually exit. With the supplement brand, you're actually building MRR and you don't have to be afraid of your ads getting shut down because you have monthly recurring revenue. Plus it's the best business model to start in 2026 anyways so that you can eventually exit. If you want to see how my students and I are actively doing this, check out my highlights.
